style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua body-cleanse visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of glacier white #F4F8FC, mist blue #D7E9F8, deep sea blue #2E5C9E and charcoal text #2E3A45; cool soft studio lighting with a gentle top-left key, airy translucent highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with translucent water-sphere accents; clean high-end body-wash photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright pump-bottle presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright pump-bottle presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
